# snipeit_accessory (Data Source)

Looks up a single accessory by `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_accessory" "mx_keys" {
  name = "Logitech MX Keys"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the accessory. Set it to look up by id.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the accessory. Set it to look up by name.

### Read-Only

- `category_id` (Number) Id of the category.
- `model_number` (String) Manufacturer model number.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `purchase_cost` (String) Purchase cost as a plain decimal string.
- `qty` (Number) Total quantity.
